Indus Waters Treaty in Abeyance; Pakistan Seeks Canada's Support

India has placed the Indus Waters Treaty in "abeyance" following the Pahalgam terror attack, with government sources stating it will not remain operational in its current form. India links any future talks on the treaty to Pakistan ending its sponsorship of terrorism. Pakistan has sought Canada's support for the restoration of the treaty. Experts and sources suggest India has the option to exit the treaty, which faces its toughest test in over 60 years.
